purpose: Driver change: YCbCr ('420f'/'420v', Metal format 500) surfaces are converted to RGB on the GPU instead of on the CPU. TWO files of Nord2Metal.bundle are replaced. libredwoodair.dylib (y2s38: the y2s34 library, reproduced bit for bit from gpu/build/y2s-stage0/build-nord2, with one object changed, air_metal.c: the new call rwa_texture_convert_ycbcr, one queued pass that samples the surface's two planes imported in place and writes the driver's BGRA texture through the matrix). Nord2Metal (y2s38: the y2s37 objects with redwoodmetal.m changed: imports the planes in place, asks the library for the pass whenever the surface changes, and keeps the y2s37 CPU conversion for any surface the GPU path refuses and for a library without the call). Previous files kept as /private/var/db/nord2-metal/Nord2Metal.pre-gpuycbcr and libredwoodair.dylib.pre-gpuycbcr; receipt.json inventory updated (both hashes). Undo: guest-gpuycbcr-undo.sh (back to y2s37-ycbcr + the y2s34 library).
